name.title: Device Name
name.description: The name of the processor as shown in Apple Home.

host.title: IP Address / Hostname
host.description: Ethernet IP address of the Trinnov Altitude.

port.title: Automation Port
port.description: Trinnov ASCII automation TCP port (default is 44100).

mac.title: MAC Address (for Wake-on-LAN)
mac.description: The Altitude network interface MAC address. Required for Power On, as the Trinnov processor enters complete standby and wakes via WoL magic packets.

minVolumeDb.title: Minimum Volume (dB)
minVolumeDb.description: Volume corresponding to 0% in HomeKit (default: -90.0 dB).

maxVolumeDb.title: Maximum Volume (dB)
maxVolumeDb.description: Volume corresponding to 100% in HomeKit (default: 0.0 dB; protects speakers from accidental max volume).

enableVolumeSlider.title: Enable Companion Volume Slider
enableVolumeSlider.description: Exposes an in-room slider in Apple Home for quick volume and mute adjustments without needing the iOS Remote widget.

enableMuteSwitch.title: Enable Mute Switch
enableMuteSwitch.description: Exposes a standalone Mute toggle switch in Apple Home.

enableBypassSwitch.title: Enable Optimizer Bypass Switch
enableBypassSwitch.description: Exposes a toggle switch to bypass or engage the Trinnov Acoustic Optimizer.

inputs.title: Input Sources (Profiles)
inputs.description: Trinnov Profile sources visible in Apple Home and iOS Remote app.

presets.title: Presets (Optional Switches)
presets.description: Expose specific Trinnov room correction presets as individual switches in Apple Home.
